note: What the identity implies about the wire. The `--daemon` answer is rendered from an envelope this process DESERIALISED, so byte-equal renderings mean the envelope crossed intact and `IndexFreshness` recomputed `complete` from the lists that arrived rather than trusting the one that was sent. Demonstrated failing rather than assumed: `Hit::stale` skipped `false` on the way out with no `default` on the way in, which made every normal answer unreadable, and this arm is what reddened -- reverting that one attribute reddens it again and nothing else.
